# WeMaAd

> WeMaAd embeds senior engineers from Cairo directly into your team — or builds your entire product end-to-end. Two models, one team.

## About

WeMaAd operates on two clear engagement models for companies that need high-quality engineering:

1. **Embed** — We place senior engineers directly inside your existing team. They work your hours, in your tools, on your codebase. Same as a full-time hire, without the overhead.
2. **Build** — We take full ownership of a product, end-to-end: from architecture and design through to deployment and delivery.

Engineers are based in Cairo, Egypt.

- **Specializations**: Ruby on Rails, Next.js, React, AI integration, SaaS development, PostgreSQL, API design
- **Location**: Cairo, Egypt
- **Contact**: hello@wemaad.net | +20 114 254 9787

## Engagement Models

### Embed
Senior engineers integrated into your team as if they were in-house. Suitable when you need to scale your team quickly with senior-level engineering talent without the cost and delay of a full-time hire.

### Build End-to-End
WeMaAd owns the full product lifecycle — discovery, architecture, design, development, testing, and deployment. Suitable when you need a complete product built from scratch or a major feature delivered independently.
